# Fixture provenance

`synthetic_btc_usdt_1h.csv` and `synthetic_btc_usdt_4h.csv` are synthetic OHLCV fixtures. They were generated deterministically with fixed arithmetic sequences (no network and no random source): open is `100 + i`, high is `102 + i`, low is `98 + i`, close is `101 + i`, and volume is `1000 + i`.

`synthetic_randomwalk_btc_1h.csv` is also synthetic, generated by `scripts/make_synthetic_fixtures.py` with fixed seed `20250101`; it contains random-walk up/down moves, varying volume, and a flat stretch from bars 120 through 139.

`orderbook_btc.json`, `funding_supported.json`, and `funding_unsupported.json` are small hand-authored fixtures for deterministic tests.

The script `scripts/record_fixtures.py` can fetch real public CCXT data and writes real recorded files named `recorded_*.csv`. Tests must continue to use only committed fixtures and never access the network.
